I want one of these! an aquatic horse exercise machine, and is still one of only two in this country. Designed and sold by IronGate Australia, the pool has room for six horses, and Vinery horses daily get in for a little exercise. The trainer running the pool explains that it’s not for swimming: “The water comes up only to their chests, not enough for them to be able to float. They’ve got to keep their feet on the ground.” In general, the horses walk for five minutes, jog for seven, and walk…
